title: The Collection for Jerusalem
lead: For years Paul gathered money from the mostly Gentile churches of Galatia, Macedonia and Achaia to carry to the poor believers in Jerusalem. He wrote about it in 1 Corinthians 16:1-4, 2 Corinthians 8-9 and Romans 15:25-32, and Acts 24:17 hints that he delivered it. It was relief for the poor, a sign that Gentile and Jewish believers belonged to one family, and, for some scholars, an offering of the nations brought to Zion.
